text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing with Maruzensky, we ended up getting lost...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what a pickle...
I just can't seem to find my way back to familiar roads~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Just because I took a little detour on a whim, this had to happen... Careless!
choice_data_list: Let's check the map on your phone.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, wait, Trainer-kun!
In times like this, there's a much better way!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, wait, Trainer-chan!
In times like this, there's a much better way!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look, there's a police box right over there, right?
Let's go ask the officer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~.
I was just hoping to ask you something~...

After asking for directions at a police box,
I managed to find my way back to familiar ground.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that settles that.
Asking a police officer was definitely the right call!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I hear you can easily look up maps with a smartphone,
but asking people directly is nice too, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Plus, it's also because I'm diligently following
the teachings my fathers gave me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Relying on someone when you're in trouble isn't something to be ashamed of," she said.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I mean, no matter how amazing someone is, they can't do everything on their own, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"When you run into a wall, keeping it all
to yourself might just lead to a dead end..."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: To make sure that doesn't happen, let's cherish our connections with everyone. Something like that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Right? Hearing you say that
makes me happy too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about relying on someone, or having someone rely on you;
it's about supporting each other...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you and I can
have that kind of relationship too."
choice_data_list: I'll do my best too, so you can rely on me even more.
I'll do my best too, so you can rely on me even more.
You support me too, you know.
You've been supporting me too, you know

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I hope you and I can have
a relationship like that, too."
choice_data_list: I'll do my best too, so you can rely on me even more.
I'll do my best too, so you can rely on me even more.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But I think you're already dependable enough as it is, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But I think you're already dependable enough as it is, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Whether during everyday training or in the biggest races, you're always there helping me out.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it's thanks to you that I can run
feeling this good, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Above all, it's thanks to you that I can run
feeling this good, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Meaning you're such a dependable, magnificent big brother that even *I* acknowledge you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: In other words, you're such a splendid, reliable big sis that even I acknowledge it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You've got my seal of approval, so hold your head high♪

At Maruzensky's words, not only joy,
but also a sense of pride welled up inside...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm glad♪
Hearing you say it again is really encouraging.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I always want to cheer you on too, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I always want to cheer you on too, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun is very earnest, but sometimes he can push himself a bit too hard.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Trainer-chan is diligent, but sometimes you tend to push yourself too hard."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Even at times like that,
as long as we have a spirit of mutual support, it's smooth sailing!”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Not just as Umamusume and Trainer,
let's combine our strength and do our best together♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We're important partners to each other, after all♪
I'm looking forward to working with you again!
